text:
Nora P: Heads up 15m 3: AcmeHealth wants to upload SOC2 extract + a full pen-test PDF into our staging bucket. They asked for a presigned link that lasts 48h and to use their KMS key. Can we do that on hosted?

Liam H: Short answer: no for hosted. Hosted only supports Redwood-managed KMS and we can't accept external CMKs. We can issue presigned links up to 7 days TTL but server-side encryption will use our key.

Raj S: Security note: letting external CMKs in hosted would break our key-rotation and audit model. If customer requires their CMK we need Private or Dedicated deployment and a commercial change.

Nora P: Ok. Theyre pushing for 48h expiry specifically because their pen-test team needs time. Would 48h presign + short retention be acceptable? Also does upload size/transfer bill to customer during POC?

Liam H: We can do 48h presign on the evidence bucket. Default staging package includes 75GB transfer + 30 days storage retention for POCs (note: number differs by contract). Anything above that is billable at normal ingress/storage rates. I'll confirm the exact bytes included for this account and post back.

Raj S: Ops/scan guidance: require uploads to a dedicated prefix: evidence/acmehealth/pen-test/YYYYMMDD/, enforce SSE-KMS header, and we will run an automated malware/vuln scan within the same hour. Recommend TTL <=48h and advise customer to upload within the agreed scan window to avoid stale credentials.

compliance-bot: Attached templates: pen-test-attest-v2.docx (legal), soc2-excerpt-redacted.pdf, upload-guidelines.md. Use pen-test-attest-v2 for signature + scope section.

Legal-Ops: If they insist on their CMK, flag as "security constraint" for sales. Private/Dedicated pricing applies. Also: for redacted network diagrams we can provide a sanitized version; full diagrams require NDA + an approved data room. Retention extensions >30 days require SOW amendment.

Nora P: Action list: 1) Liam to confirm included staging bytes for AcmeHealth and whether the account billing tier modifies 75GB default. 2) Raj to provide the exact bucket policy snippet and recommended prefix naming. 3) Legal-Ops to prepare the redacted diagram + short blurb on CMK escalation path. I'll reply to customer with the 48h presign option and caveats. Back to me by EOD.

Liam H: Will confirm bytes and post the account-specific numbers here.

Raj S: Bucket policy snippet (example) attached in DM. Quick paste:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowPutOnlyToPrefix",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "s3:PutObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/evidence/acmehealth/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Raj S: Note: we will enforce metadata tag `scan=pen-test` on uploads via lifecycle hook so the scanner picks them up.

Legal-Ops: Redacted diagram ready; will drop link in channel. Also prepared the legal blurb re: CMK and retention.

Nora P: Thanks team. Ill take the 48h presign + note about CMK/retention to the customer and keep them on the flow for Private/Dedicated if they require CMK control. Closing once customer confirms.

Liam H: +1

Raj S: +1

Legal-Ops: +1
